historicalStableContract.rule: Cliente360 is client-centric. Country defines the visible client universe first; KPIs use that full universe. The list is paginated and first paint is bounded. Policy-derived data is progressive and must not block the client list.
historicalStableContract.provenHarnessPattern: Compare independent scoped client universe to data-c360-kpi-client-count for CO/GT/TODOS; do not equate first-page text with full-universe membership.

rootCause: The R14 B4-003 assertion required the synthetic QA client name to occur in host.innerText immediately after rendering GT. Cliente360 renders only the current 40-row page, so a valid client outside page 1 produces syntheticClientVisible=false even when the authoritative store and KPI universe are correct.
fixContract: Reuse the previously proven B3-008 universe assertion pattern.
Assert synthetic client exists in authoritative store.
Assert UI full-universe count equals the canonical GT client universe after merged-client exclusion.
Use Cliente360 search to prove the synthetic client is reachable without assuming page-1 placement.
Do not change product source, page size, data, scope rules, reimport, or LIVE.
